From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Elena Soto <esoto@brightwave.com>, BrightWave Procurement <procurement@brightwave.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: add seats + 12mo term extension / order form attached

Quick technical read:
- Steady state 1.5M tokens/month + occasional burst to 3M is fine from a serving perspective. We need a clarified burst definition in the SLA (e.g., sustained tokens/minute threshold for >60s).
- Data residency: BrightWave requested EU region for a subset of traffic. We can support partitioning via region policy but need to capture which model endpoints and which customer data streams are scoped.
- Onboarding: recommend a two‑week warmup window (prefill caches, model priming) with staged traffic shift. Start date 8/15 is OK if contract signed by 7/30 and we receive the usage plan spreadsheet (attached).

Proposed redline language for SLA: "Burst capacity defined as any sustained upstream request rate exceeding 250k tokens/min for longer than 60 seconds; Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to satisfy burst requests subject to available capacity and will provide a 4‑hour operational notice window for scheduled bursts >2M tokens."

I'll draft the suggested paragraphs and drop them in the marked MSA.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Elena — attaching the consolidated package for your review: Redwood_MSA_v3_marked.pdf (redlines), BrightWave_OrderForm_v2.docx (final quantities + billing rows), BrightWave_Usage_Plan.xlsx.

Summary of edits based on our thread:
- Added a short SLA addendum defining burst capacity and notification windows (per Monica's proposal).
- Data residency clause scoped for EU traffic subset — please confirm the endpoint list in the Usage Plan.
- One‑time onboarding credit and 3mo volume discount included in the order form (see commercial notes).

DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABCD1234 — intended recipients: Elena Soto (sig), BrightWave Procurement (sig), David Kim (redwood exec sig). Please flag any redlines to legal@redwood.com by 7/30 so we can hit the target sign date of 7/31 and start onboarding on 8/15.

If everything looks good I'll route to Legal to accept the small MSA language changes.

Thanks — looking forward to scaling together.

David Kim
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
